QUOTE: "Without `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS`, `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(foo)` expands to `private_foo`... so application code that writes `ctx->foo` fails to compile... With the define, it expands to `foo`" and "Applications are the ones who get the rename."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer contrasts code that defines the macro, which sees plain names, with ordinary application consumers, who see the `private_` renamed members.
